input.task: Reload the inspector's source pane and report the inventory turnover.

provenance: T-M42-4, the direction the decoy cases must not break: scoping a postcondition to the acted document is only correct if the frame-scoped click keeps its OWN document as its verification scope — the iframe'd page has to stay verifiable, which is what M42 leg (a) bought and what `check_state`'s frame reach existed for in the first place. The `Reload source` button and the predicate string both live in `frames-inner.html`, so the click resolves in the frame and its `text_visible` holds THERE; a fix that scoped every postcondition to the main document would turn this red (`postcondition_ok: false` on a click verified by its own pane). `resolved_scopes` also pins the trace field itself — `resolved.scope`, the document URL `resolve` returned from (asserted as a URL-substring per step, because fixture URLs carry the suite's ephemeral loopback port; null where nothing resolved) — which is the field T-M42-14's frames-aware `page_changed` repro is specified to consume, and which ADR-028 §7 as amended by ADR-036 permits. Watched red first: before the fix `resolved` carried no `scope` key at all, so this case failed on `resolved_scopes` while its status, answer and postconditions were already green.

triage.note: the positive twin of the two decoy cases; also the pin on the resolved.scope trace field
